title: 西爽村宫门 Xi Shuang Cun Gong Men
subtitle: Gate in the garden walls

evidence.title: 绮春园 宫门 names (as quoted in S220)
evidence.date: 嘉庆十三年 1808; 同治十二年 1873
evidence.locator: S220, passage on the 嘉庆十三年 edict; section 五
evidence.excerpt_zh: 西爽村着仍称绮春园宫门（即绮春园西宫门），嗣后一切称谓书写，俱不得再有西爽村字样
evidence.summary: An edict makes 西爽村 the west gate of the garden. In 1873 the west gate by 清夏斋 becomes 南宫门. S01's 西爽村宫门 fits the first and has not the name of the second.

evidence.title: 围墙 and gates between the three gardens (S57 = S116)
evidence.summary: Between 圆明园 and 长春园: 明春门, 绿油门, 蕊珠门. Between 绮春园 and 长春园: 茜园门. Between 绮春园 and 圆明园: 秀清村门. Today's wall file names 藻园门, 西爽村门, 运料门, 绿油门, 福缘门 and 东楼门 as sites of wall gates, 西北门 and 大北门 by their walls. 绿油门 is not labelled on S01.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn as a gate on the plan of the gardens (S01).
